digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command dispatch
propositions: Advanced command grammars in bridge/reconciler, audit, LLM/review, workflow, identity, and gate commands are currently mixed between inline argparse construction and manual dispatch, causing 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms.

Parser factories must be extracted and reused across command families while remaining in lean modules that do not import optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing).
RebarArgumentParser must raise ParseError instead of SystemExit(2) on parse failure, and all migrated handlers must catch both exception types to preserve identical exit codes and stderr output.
Parser construction must succeed in no-extras environments without importing handler executors, providers, or optional runtimes, proving S2d generation readiness.
Bespoke parser presentation (usage, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help) must be preserved exactly for affected commands via optional keyword parameters in the S2a factory.
